question: What is the projected growth rate of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for India in 2021 as given by the international Monetary Fund (IMF) in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.5%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **12.5% of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for India in 2021 was given by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in April 2021.**
 
• The IMF expected world output to grow 6% in 2021 and 4.4% in 2022.
 
• Advanced economies are projected to grow 5.1% in 2021, with the US and Spain expected to rebound the fastest at 6.4% each.
 
• According to India’s statistics office, the economy contracted 8% in FY21 while the Economic Survey 2020-21 sees 11% growth in FY22.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IMF was established in **1944**.
 
• The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an organization of 190 countries, working to foster global monetary cooperation, secure financial stability, facilitate international trade, promote high employment and sustainable economic growth, and reduce poverty around the world.
 
• **World Economic Outlook, Global financial stability reports,** and **Regional Economic Reports** are published by IMF.
 
• Managing Director of IMF: **Kristalina Georgieva (Apr 2022)**
 
• Headquarters:** Washington DC**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Economic survey 2021-22:**

 
 
• As per IMF’s latest World Economic Outlook projections, India’s real GDP is projected to grow at **9 per cent in 2021-22 and 2022-23 and at 7.1 per cent in 2023-2024.**
 
• Which would make India the fastest-growing major economy in the world for all 3years.
